definitions.gloss: Kutani ware: brightly enameled porcelain from Ishikawa Prefecture
definitions.explanation: Porcelain from the Kaga area of Ishikawa Prefecture, famous for bold overglaze enamels in green, yellow, purple, dark blue and red. Production began in the seventeenth century, and pieces from that first period are called Ko-Kutani (old Kutani).

examples.english: When I traveled to Kanazawa, I bought a Kutani ware teacup as a souvenir.

notes:
The five classic colors are called {九谷五彩|くたにごさい}. Kutani is one of the best-known crafts of Kanazawa and the Hokuriku region, alongside gold leaf and lacquer.
